research_result.description: Twenty is an open-source CRM platform offering auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, custom data objects, native MCP server integration, and developer extensibility.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can self-host the open-source core for free or sign up for a Cloud trial (7 days without a card or 30 days with a card). API keys can be generated directly under Settings -> API & Webhooks, and OAuth applications can register programmatically via dynamic registration.

evidence.claim: Twenty supports OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE and client credentials flows.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Twenty implements OAuth 2.0 with authorization code + PKCE for user-facing apps and client credentials for server-to-server access.

evidence.claim: Twenty explicitly supports API Keys for programmatic access.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: API keys provide programmatic access to your workspace.

evidence.claim: Twenty explicitly supports JWT tokens for session-based web application authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Secure your API requests with Twenty's authentication system supporting API keys, OAuth tokens, and JWT.

evidence.claim: Twenty uses Bearer Token header format for API request authorization.
Twenty offers schema-per-tenant REST and GraphQL APIs.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: REST and GraphQL APIs generated from your workspace schema.

evidence.claim: Twenty Cloud workspaces include a native MCP server.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Every Cloud workspace ships with a native MCP server.

evidence.claim: Twenty core is free to self-host.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Self-host the open source core for free, or upgrade to Organization for SSO and row-level permissions.
